{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of response by gender and treatment arm
response_by_gender_arm = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'], values=df['responded'], aggfunc='mean')
print('Average response rate by gender and arm:\n', response_by_gender_arm)

# Compute overall response rates by gender
overall_response_by_gender = df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print('\nOverall response rate by gender:\n', overall_response_by_gender)

# Check if gender is balanced across arms
gender_by_arm = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], df['arm'])
print('\nGender distribution by arm:\n', gender_by_arm)

# Compute response rate difference by gender within each arm
response_diff_per_arm = df.groupby(['arm', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='sex')
response_diff_per_arm['diff'] = response_diff_per_arm['F'] - response_diff_per_arm['M']
print('\nResponse rate difference by gender within each arm:\n', response_diff_per_arm)"}
